from collections import Counter

def recs(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        lines=[x.rstrip('\\n') for x in f]
    return Counter(zip(lines[1::4], lines[3::4]))
R={x:recs(f'exogenous.mix.reads.q1.{x}.fq') for x in ('exo','endo','mix')}
for x in R:
    print(x, 'total',sum(R[x].values()),'unique',len(R[x]))
for a,b in [('exo','endo'),('exo','mix'),('endo','mix')]:
    inter=set(R[a])&set(R[b])
    print(a,b,'unique intersection',len(inter),'multiset overlap',sum(min(R[a][k],R[b][k]) for k in inter))
    print('records in b matching a (with multiplicity)',sum(R[b][k] for k in R[a]))
print('mix source exact assignment:')
print('endo',sum(R['mix'][k] for k in R['endo']))
print('exo',sum(R['mix'][k] for k in R['exo']))
print('both',sum(R['mix'][k] for k in set(R['endo'])&set(R['exo'])))
print('unmatched',sum(v for k,v in R['mix'].items() if k not in R['exo'] and k not in R['endo']))
# frequency relationships
for name in ('exo','endo'):
    vals=[R['mix'][k] for k in R[name]]
    print(name,'mix count for records',Counter(vals), 'sum',sum(vals))

from urllib.request import urlopen
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
import re
url='https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=nuccore&id=NM_004235.4&rettype=fasta&retmode=text'
raw=urlopen(url,timeout=30).read().decode()
ref=''.join(raw.splitlines()[1:]).upper()
print('reference length',len(ref),raw.splitlines()[0])

def reads(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        ls=[x.strip() for x in f]
    return [ls[i] for i in range(1,len(ls),4)]
for name in ('exo','endo','mix'):
    rs=reads(f'exogenous.mix.reads.q1.{name}.fq')
    exact=0; rev=0; no=0; poss=0; positions=[]
    for s in rs:
        p=ref.find(s)
        rc=s.translate(str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA'))[::-1]
        q=ref.find(rc)
        if p>=0: exact+=1; positions.append(p)
        elif q>=0: exact+=1; rev+=1; positions.append(q)
        else: no+=1
    print(name,'n',len(rs),'exact',exact,'rev',rev,'not exact',no,'unique positions',len(set(positions)),'pos range', (min(positions),max(positions)) if positions else None)

from urllib.request import urlopen
from collections import Counter
import math
ref=''.join(urlopen('https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=nuccore&id=NM_004235.4&rettype=fasta&retmode=text',timeout=30).read().decode().splitlines()[1:]).upper()
tr=str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA')
def get(path):
  with open(path) as f: ls=[x.strip() for x in f]
  return [ls[i] for i in range(1,len(ls),4)]
def coord(s):
  p=ref.find(s)
  if p>=0:return p,0
  p=ref.find(s.translate(tr)[::-1])
  if p>=0:return p,1
  return None
for n in ('exo','endo','mix'):
  cs=[coord(s) for s in get(f'exogenous.mix.reads.q1.{n}.fq')]
  exact=[p for p in cs if p]
  print('\\n',n,'total',len(cs),'exact',len(exact),'not',len(cs)-len(exact))
  print('orientation',Counter(o for p,o in exact))
  print('bins 0-600,600-1983,1983+',Counter('5UTR' if p<600 else 'CDS' if p<=1983 else '3UTR' for p,o in exact))
  print('start quartiles', [sorted(p for p,o in exact)[int(len(exact)*q)] for q in (0,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,.99)])
  bins=Counter((p//100)*100 for p,o in exact)
  print('bins:', ' '.join(f'{b}:{bins[b]}' for b in sorted(bins)))
